contract.userJob: Work through a bounded set of tasks while preserving completion state and context.

layout.compact: Use one task column with tap-safe state controls and concise detail.

contract.fallback: Preserve every grounded task, prerequisite, caution, and completion condition.

gaps: Visual hierarchy and component styling do not yet meet the web North Star.

quality.nextAction: Use the scenario-builder workflow to redesign checklist hierarchy, task states, and compact behavior.
